errors.text: The FEP mechanism is described as perturbing the system along a coupling parameter to obtain the solid-liquid free-energy difference; this conflates FEP with thermodynamic integration. The relevant FEP step uses exponential averaging of small MTP-to-DFT energy differences sampled from the MTP ensemble.

The required SRO finite-size boundary is not reconstructed: the target uses a 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell, whereas the hypothesis only estimates more than 100 atoms without a size-convergence protocol.

The hypothesis implies that a classical MTP preserves electronic DOS-gap features. Electronic excitation free energies must be evaluated separately from the interatomic potential unless an explicitly electronic-temperature-dependent model is constructed.
